title: LM-From-Zero course: full correctness + quality review
task: review all this I want this to be insanely good

stories.title: Fix inverted top-p (nucleus) mask in lm/generate.py
acceptanceCriteria: lm/generate.py generate() keeps the smallest prefix of sorted tokens whose cumulative mass exceeds top_p and sets ALL OTHER logits to -inf (currently inverted: it -infs the nucleus and samples the tail)
A new test asserts that with a sharply peaked logit vector, generate() at low top_p returns only tokens inside the nucleus (would fail on the pre-fix code)
test_generate_top_p_near_one_does_not_collapse still passes
test_generate_never_samples_padded_vocab still passes

stories.title: Fix inverted iterative-unmasking schedule in lm/mdlm.py
acceptanceCriteria: mdlm_generate reveals a monotonically non-decreasing number of tokens across steps and finishes only at the final step (currently reveals ~80% on step 1 and no-ops on steps 2..n-1)
A new test asserts that after step i of `steps`, the number of still-masked positions is approximately L*(1 - i/steps)
mdlm_generate with a prompt keeps the prompt clean and the schedule accounts for prompt tokens already known
tests/test_mdlm.py passes in full

stories.title: Fix ValueHead masking poisoning GAE in lm/rm.py
acceptanceCriteria: ValueHead.forward no longer emits -1e9 at masked positions (which propagates through gae() and yields |advantage| ~ 1e7 at REAL completion positions when the batch has trailing padding)
A new test builds a batch with trailing padding, runs gae() over ValueHead output, and asserts all advantages at unmasked positions are finite and O(1)
test_gae_shapes_and_baseline and test_ppo_step_runs still pass

stories.title: Remove dead/no-op code paths in lm/rm.py
acceptanceCriteria: `hidden = self.lm(x)[0] if False else self._last_hidden(x)` is replaced by a direct call
bradley_terry_loss's `margin` parameter either does something or is removed (currently `diff if not margin else diff` — both branches identical)
The duplicated _last_hidden implementation in RewardModel and ValueHead is shared, not copy-pasted
ppo_step computes the policy log-probs once instead of three separate forward passes, and its KL term is documented honestly
grep -n 'if False' lm/ returns nothing

stories.title: Fix lm/mamba.py: device-broken hybrid + block that contradicts its docstring
acceptanceCriteria: MambaHybrid computes RoPE freqs once (registered buffer or cached) on the model's device instead of rebuilding a CPU tensor on every forward
A new test runs MambaHybrid forward and asserts freqs live on the same device as the parameters (guards the CUDA crash)
MambaBlock's forward matches its own docstring: separate x/gate branches from in_proj, SiLU after the depthwise conv, gate applied to the OTHER branch
MambaBlock's x_proj no longer allocates an unused +1 output dimension
tests/test_comprehensive.py::TestMamba passes and a new test asserts MambaModel is causal (position t's logits do not change when tokens after t change)

stories.title: Fix GPTQ calibration in lm/quant.py
acceptanceCriteria: gptq_model accumulates calibration activations across all calibration batches instead of keeping only the last one (current hook overwrites inputs[name] every forward, so the '~8 calibration batches' loop is a no-op)
A new test asserts the captured calibration matrix has rows from more than one batch
Int8Linear's docstring no longer claims W8A8 when only weights are quantized
NF4.quantize no longer writes the unused `cls._block` class attribute
tests/test_lora_quant.py passes in full

stories.title: Make --profile actually profile in lm/train.py
acceptanceCriteria: The torch profiler is started and stopped (context manager or explicit start/stop) so prof.step() is legal, and a trace/table is emitted at the end
A test runs a short train() with profile=True and asserts it completes and produces profiler output
Unused imports (json, torch.nn.functional as F, _VOCAB_SIZE) are removed from lm/train.py
Resuming loads the checkpoint once, not twice

stories.title: Fix device-parameter overrides and speculative-decoding cache desync
acceptanceCriteria: speculative_generate no longer overwrites its `device` argument with a global cuda check
agent_loop no longer overwrites its `device` argument
speculative_generate does not feed an already-cached token to the draft when the draft loop breaks on an out-of-vocab sample (draft cache and draft_ids stay consistent)
tests/test_comprehensive.py::TestSpeculative passes in full

stories.title: Fix tie_embeddings init clobber in lm/model.py
acceptanceCriteria: With tie_embeddings=True the shared weight is initialized with the embedding std (init_std), not the residual-scaled Linear std applied afterwards by Module.apply ordering
A test asserts the tied weight's std is within tolerance of init_std, and that untied models keep the residual-scaled head init

stories.title: Supervise the image->first-caption-token transition in lm/vlm.py
acceptanceCriteria: Transformer.forward's prefix_embeds target padding leaves the LAST prefix position supervised with the first text token, instead of -100 (currently the image->first token transition is never trained)
A test asserts the VLM loss changes when only the first caption token changes
tests/test_sae_vlm.py::TestVLM passes in full, including test_loss_only_on_text

stories.title: Correct the serving demo's decode step in lm/serving.py
acceptanceCriteria: ContinuousBatcher keeps a real per-batch KV cache across decode steps so each request's next token is conditioned on its full history (currently `cache=None` with a 1-token input, so every step conditions on one token)
The misleading comment '1 token: no cache needed' is gone
A test asserts that two batcher steps produce logits that depend on the earlier tokens (cache is actually used)
tests/test_comprehensive.py::TestServing passes in full

stories.title: Clean up dead code, wrong comments, and slop across lm/
acceptanceCriteria: lm/lora.py's math_sqrt5() indirection is removed in favour of a module-level `import math`
lm/vlm.py's `IMG_TOKEN_ID = None  # not used` is removed

lm/data.py: the wrong '0.5M vocab fits uint16' comment is corrected, the unused `split` parameter and unused `tokenize_doc` import are removed, and TokenizedFile raises a clear error when the .bin is shorter than seq_len+1
lm/sae.py encode() scatters along the last dim so it works for both [N,f] and [B,T,f]
lm/dpo.py: kto_loss's meaningless F.kl_div over a per-sequence 1-D tensor is replaced with a correct reference point, and simpo_loss's docstring no longer double-counts the 1/|y| normalization
lm/grpo.py code_reward uses sys.executable rather than bare 'python'
lm/agent.py Calculator rejects '**' (or otherwise bounds the expression) so a generated `9**9**9` cannot hang the loop
The empty Implementations/setup.py + stray Implementations/.venv cruft is removed or explained
`python -m compileall lm scripts` succeeds and no unused imports remain in the files touched

Every runnable snippet in the modules is executed or statically checked; broken snippets are fixed
Factual/technical errors (numbers, formulas, paper attributions, architecture claims) are corrected with the correct value
Any module text describing behaviour changed by US-001..US-012 is updated to match

stories.title: Regression tests lock in every fix and the suite passes clean
acceptanceCriteria: Each new test in US-001..US-011 fails on the pre-fix code and passes after (verified by reverting the fix or by direct reasoning recorded in progress.txt)
`python -m pytest -q` passes with 0 failures and 0 errors
The README's test-count claim matches the actual collected count
No test is skipped, deleted, or weakened to make the suite green
